_help: Words that are not allowed in nicknames and in answers shown on the big screen. Add your own words to either list and restart the server. Write them in plain form: the filter ignores case, spaces, symbols, repeated letters and Hebrew vowel marks, and treats final letters (ך ם ן ף ץ) like regular ones. Words of 3 letters or fewer only match as a whole word, longer ones also match inside a longer text. Keep ordinary words out of the list (a name or answer that contains them is hidden). 'allow' lists innocent words that contain a listed word, so they are not blocked.
